name: SilverTrend v3
summary: SilverTrend v3 is a trend-following expert advisor that generates buy and sell signals based on a SilverTrend signal indicator, which uses price action and ATR-based thresholds to detect trend direction changes. It automatically opens positions when the indicator identifies a new trend direction and can close them on reversal signals. The EA is designed for capturing medium-term trend movements on major currency pairs.
summary_zh: SilverTrend v3是一个趋势跟踪型EA，基于SilverTrend信号指标产生买卖信号，该指标利用价格行为和ATR阈值来检测趋势方向变化。当指标识别到新的趋势方向时自动开仓，并在反转信号出现时平仓。该EA专为捕捉主要货币对的中期趋势行情而设计。
strategy_analysis: SilverTrend v3的核心策略概念是基于SilverTrend信号指标的趋势跟踪，该指标通过计算价格在一定周期内的高低点并结合ATR波动率阈值来判断趋势方向的变化。入场条件为：当指标发出买入信号（通常为价格突破下降趋势线或低点抬升）时做多，当发出卖出信号（价格跌破上升趋势线或高点降低）时做空。出场条件主要依赖反向信号的出现，即在趋势反转信号触发时平掉当前持仓。仓位管理方面，该EA通常使用固定手数或基于账户余额的简单比例计算，缺乏动态仓位调整机制。资金管理较为基础，没有明确的止损设置或追踪止损功能，仅依赖信号反转来退出交易，这在震荡行情中可能导致频繁的虚假信号和连续亏损。整体策略逻辑简单直观，但缺乏对市场状态（趋势/震荡）的过滤机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of SilverTrend v3 is trend following based on the SilverTrend signal indicator, which determines trend direction changes by calculating price highs and lows over a given period combined with ATR volatility thresholds. Entry conditions are: go long when the indicator issues a buy signal (typically a breakout above a descending trend line or higher low formation), and go short when a sell signal appears (price breaking below an ascending trend line or lower high formation). Exit conditions primarily rely on the appearance of a reversal signal, closing the current position when the trend reversal is triggered. Position sizing typically uses fixed lots or a simple proportion based on account balance, lacking dynamic position adjustment mechanisms. Money management is relatively basic, with no explicit stop loss or trailing stop functionality, relying solely on signal reversal to exit trades, which can lead to frequent false signals and consecutive losses during ranging markets. The overall strategy logic is simple and intuitive but lacks a market state filter (trend vs. range) to avoid choppy conditions.

parameters.name: RISK
parameters.description: 风险百分比，用于计算每笔交易的手数
parameters.description_en: Risk percentage for lot size calculation

parameters.name: SSP
parameters.description: SilverTrend指标的周期参数，用于计算高低点

parameters.name: Kmax
parameters.description: ATR乘数系数，用于调整信号灵敏度阈值
parameters.description_en: ATR multiplier for signal sensitivity threshold

parameters.name: CountBars
parameters.description: 计算指标时使用的K线数量
parameters.description_en: Number of bars for indicator calculation

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不使用止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不使用止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points; close on cumulative profit

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 追踪止损点数，0表示不使用追踪止损

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调试
基于ATR的动态阈值能自适应市场波动率变化
趋势行情中表现良好，能捕捉中长期趋势
参数较少，优化空间适中，不易过度拟合
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and debug
ATR-based dynamic threshold adapts to market volatility changes
Performs well in trending markets, capturing medium-to-long-term trends
Few parameters with moderate optimization space, less prone to overfitting
cons: 缺乏止损机制导致单笔交易风险不可控
震荡行情中容易产生频繁虚假信号造成连续亏损
没有市场状态过滤机制，无法区分趋势和震荡行情
仓位管理过于简单，没有考虑波动率动态调整
出场仅依赖反向信号，回撤可能较大
cons_en: Lack of stop loss mechanism leads to uncontrolled per-trade risk
Prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets
No market state filter to distinguish trending from ranging conditions
Position sizing is overly simplistic without volatility-based dynamic adjustment
Exit relies solely on reversal signals, potentially leading to large drawdowns
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损和追踪止损功能以控制风险
添加趋势强度过滤器（如ADX）避免在震荡行情中交易
实现基于波动率的动态仓位管理（如ATR倒数仓位法）
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and trailing stop functionality for risk control
Implement a trend strength filter (e.g., ADX) to avoid trading in ranging markets
Implement volatility-based dynamic position sizing (e.g., inverse ATR position sizing)

risk_points: 默认止损和止盈均为0，单笔交易风险敞口无限
没有持仓检查和重复开仓保护，可能在同一信号上多次开仓
缺乏新K线检查，可能在同一根K线上反复交易
risk_points_en: Default stop loss and take profit are both 0, exposing unlimited per-trade risk
No position check or duplicate order protection, may open multiple positions on the same signal
Lack of new bar check, may trade repeatedly on the same bar

It automatically opens positions when the indicator identifies a new trend direction and can close them on reversal signals. The EA is designed for capturing medium-term trend movements on major currency pairs.
